Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at FinTech Corp is excited to move forward with the POC. We'd like to kick off a hands-on working session where we can: review prompt sets, discuss routing and model variants, and run an initial set of load tests/benchmarks.

High-level goals:
- Validate routing & fallbacks under load
- Throughput target: ~200-300 req/s (we can be specific once you propose a test harness)
- Latency SLOs: p95 <= 300ms for our typical prompt size

Proposed dates: Mar 8-10 (US/PST mornings preferred). Can you and your SEs join? We'll need an invite for a 2-3 hour hands-on session and a short pre-kickoff tech sync.

Also: can you share the test harness and any sample configs/attachments we should review ahead of time?

Thanks,
Alex

Alex,

Quick technical note ahead of the session so we can converge on targets:

- Test harness: we use a JMeter/Locust-based harness (we'll provide the repo and a wrapper script).
- Suggested ramp plan: 0 -> 50 -> 150 -> target for 10m each stage, then soak for 20m.
- Metrics we'll capture: qps, p95/p99 latency, GPU utilization, token/sec, error rates (4xx/5xx), and model fallback counts.
- Config: sample YAML attached (load_test_config.yaml) — you'll want to confirm average input token length (we used 120 tokens in our samples).

One thing to confirm: is 200-300 req/s your target at the client-request level, or after batching? Also, how many concurrent sessions/users should we simulate (we typically model realistic request arrival patterns).

If you confirm the exact target (req/s and concurrent users) we'll pre-configure the harness so the session can run cleanly during the hands-on.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
